notes:
- 🎉 Photo viewing now supports swipe-through paging, pinch and double-tap zoom, and an easy pull-down close.
- Writing feels more natural, with familiar keyboard shortcuts and smoother formatting, editing, search, and photo controls.
- Getting around is smoother, with finger-tracked pages and sheets, swipe-back navigation, and better keyboard focus.
- Your Life Map loads quickly, updates as you add or remove items, and lets you undo changes.
- App lock is easier to use, with clear passcode dots, quick unlock on the final digit, and a shake when a PIN is incorrect.
